title: Implement mock CLI adapter for testing
description:
## Goal
Create a mock implementation of the ContainerCLI behaviour that returns fixture data for tests without hitting the real CLI.

## Module
lib/flame/apple_containers/cli/mock.ex → FLAME.AppleContainers.CLI.Mock

## Design
- Implements all ContainerCLI behaviour callbacks
- Returns responses based on captured 0.9.0 fixtures
- Supports configurable scenarios (success, error, timeout)
- Can be per-process configured for async test support (use process dictionary or Agent)
- No external mock library needed - pure behaviour-based

## Scenarios to support
- Happy path: all operations succeed
- Container not found: inspect/stop/kill return not-found errors
- DNS unavailable: dns commands return errors
- Resource exhaustion: run returns capacity errors
- Timeout: exec commands hang

## Pattern
```elixir
defmodule FLAME.AppleContainers.CLI.Mock do
  @behaviour FLAME.AppleContainers.CLI

  def list_dns_domains do
    case get_scenario(:dns) do
      :success -> {:ok, ["flame.local", "container.local"]}
      :error -> {:error, :dns_unavailable}
    end
  end
  # ...
end
```

## Suggested Skills
- elixir:testing: Mock patterns without external libraries
- elixir:otp: Process-based test isolation
close_reason: Implemented Mock adapter at lib/flame/apple_containers/cli/mock.ex with process dictionary responses

title: Refactor SecurityManager to accept server param (pattern template)
description:
## Goal
Establish the refactoring pattern by converting SecurityManager (simplest module, 4 API functions).

## Pattern to apply
1. Add optional `server` param (default `__MODULE__`) to `start_link/1`
2. Change all public API functions to accept optional `server \\ __MODULE__` param
3. Pass `server` to `GenServer.call/cast` instead of `__MODULE__`

### Before
```elixir
def start_link(opts) do
  GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
end

def get_security_status do
  GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_security_status)
end
```

### After
```elixir
def start_link(opts) do
  name = Keyword.get(opts, :name, __MODULE__)
  GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: name)
end

def get_security_status(server \\ __MODULE__) do
  GenServer.call(server, :get_security_status)
end
```

## Functions to update (4)
- `validate_function/2` → `validate_function/3`
- `execute_safely/3` → `execute_safely/4`
- `audit_log/2` → `audit_log/3` (cast)
- `get_security_status/0` → `get_security_status/1`

## Test updates
- `test/flame/security_manager_test.exs`: Start isolated instance, pass pid to API calls
- Enable `async: true`

## Suggested Skills
- elixir:otp: GenServer naming patterns
- elixir:anti-patterns: Using Application config for libraries
- elixir:testing: Async test isolation
close_reason: SecurityManager accepts server param (name: in start_link, server \ __MODULE__ in API). Tests use async: true with unique names. Committed 9c7d3fb. CI green.

title: Define ContainerCLI behaviour with callbacks for all CLI operations
description:
## Goal
Create a behaviour module at lib/flame/apple_containers/cli.ex that defines callbacks for every container CLI operation used in the codebase.

## Commands to abstract (from container CLI 0.9.0)
1. container system dns list → list_dns_domains/0
2. container system dns default get → get_default_dns_domain/0
3. container run <args> → run_container/1 (accepts map of options)
4. container inspect <name> → inspect_container/1
5. container exec <name> <cmd> → exec_in_container/2
6. container stop <name> --time <sec> → stop_container/2
7. container kill <name> → kill_container/1
8. container stats <name> --no-stream → get_container_stats/1
9. hostname → get_hostname/0

## Pattern
```elixir
defmodule FLAME.AppleContainers.CLI do
  @callback list_dns_domains() :: {:ok, [String.t()]} | {:error, term()}
  @callback run_container(opts :: map()) :: {:ok, String.t()} | {:error, term()}
  # ... etc
end
```

## Acceptance criteria
- All 9 CLI operations have typed callbacks
- Return types use {:ok, _} | {:error, _} tuples consistently
- Module has @moduledoc explaining it's the adapter interface for container CLI

## Suggested Skills
- elixir:otp: Behaviour definition patterns
